task_meta.title: Split a 600-line service without changing behaviour

claim_text:
I've split `OrderService` up. It's now a 152-line coordinator with exactly the same public API: the same constructor, constants and ten public methods, and no new public types. All the new classes are `internal`. The existing tests in `tests/` pass.
